amherst_192.identity_basis: Cambridge I.3 preface v maps U6 to Amherst II 192; Wevers introduction maps Amherst 192 to 916
amherst_192.locator: 1901 edition p. 202, CXCII fragment (a), recto line 2, verse 8
amherst_192.discrimination: The printed unbracketed prefix distinguishes the angel noun from the sons noun at this location; the ending and following divine designation are not independently attested by this quoted line.
amherst_192.image_inspection: Plate XXIV, CXCII recto, fragments a and b located in an overview; no independent letter-by-letter image transcription or measured crop claimed
amherst_192.genre_qualification: Kraft's Amherst reassessment proposes an excerpt anthology on comparative material grounds; not an established continuous Pentateuch codex

cambridge_106_report.locator: 1911 edition p. 661, middle apparatus, verse 8, lemma αγγελων θεου
cambridge_106_report.normalization_note: Expand printed overlined Israel abbreviation; this is not a diplomatic manuscript transcription
cambridge_106_report.identity: Cambridge p = 106, Ferrara Biblioteca Comunale Gr. 187 (1906 preface vi); also verified in Wevers's Deuteronomy introduction
cambridge_106_report.hand: Cambridge superscript b denotes a later correcting hand for this cursive manuscript (1906 preface v)
cambridge_106_report.qualification: Retain the edition's uid/vid uncertainty qualification; no precise corrector date or direct hand inspection
cambridge_106_report.conflicting_report: Tov's online table groups 848 and 106c under sons of God; not accepted as verified complete-phrase support from 106c after this check
cambridge_106_report.resolution_status: Exact modern apparatus and manuscript correction remain uninspected; no definitive claim of a changed scholarly reading or cause of discrepancy
